desc: Analyze the game in terms of connected components and their bipartition sizes.
Determine the Grundy value of a single component based on its bipartition sizes and number of edges.
Understand how merging two components affects the Grundy value and derive a rule for combining components.
Implement a solution that computes the Grundy value of the whole graph efficiently (O(N) or O(N log N)).
Test the solution on various cases, including the provided samples and the counterexample found.
